title: tylophora tomentosa
intro: Tylophora tomentosa, commonly known as Madhu rubra or Madhu, is a perennial climber of the Apocynaceae family. This plant is known for its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its various health benefits. The health benefits of Tylophora tomentosa include its ability to treat asthma, bronchitis, and other respiratory issues, as well as its potential to reduce fever and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of inhibiting inflammatory mediators and exhibiting antioxidant activity.
